mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 enzymes, with tolterodine metabolism significantly affected by escitalopram, and additive anticholinergic and CNS effects.
action: Monitor for increased tolterodine adverse effects (anticholinergic symptoms, CNS depression, QT prolongation); consider dose reduction or alternative antimuscarinic agent; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
